column2: This conversation is an interview with a candidate. Based on this conversation, write a concise bio of the candidate’s career history. Do not embellish on the points made in the notes, but do make sure the account is well-written and tells the complete story. It is important that the key points are captured accurately, as noted, without new information added. The output should be a well-structured bio that organizes the key points. Use complete sentences, in conversational format, with no bullet points. Write the bio in two short paragraphs.
Review this conversation for any key action items resulting from the discussion.  Summarize those action items, grouped by speaker.

Describe this conversation in two or three paragraphs, as if describing it to a third party who was not involved.  Use conversational language, making sure to capture all the key points and the overall intent of the conversation.
